title: 第90章 【正文完】
content_zh:
临近年关,展颜买了些礼物，带上孙晚秋的钱，往小展村去。她叫不动孙晚秋,也不会叫她。
村子里多了几辆车,很惹眼,那必定是谁家混好了。她小时候，一入夏,自黄昏起，路两旁便睡满了人，铺着凉席。她也睡过,一翻身，瞧见不远处谁家的牛,正在拉屎，她被巨大无比的□□惊吓住,眼睁睁看着牛屎大坨大坨掉落,砸到地上。道路上哪有车，尽是人，谁要是骑个摩托过去,大家要张望很久,目送这人，直到看不见了为止才收回目光。
离开土地的，总归有人发了点小财,在外头什么样不晓得,但车子往门口一停,人们就会讲一讲,又羡慕又嫉妒。倘若谁家的女儿,从外头回来给家里置办许多东西,那她在人嘴里，定是在外卖的，为实为虚，谁晓得哩。
但展颜回来，人只会说展有庆这三脚跺不出屁的，有福。第一个婆娘十里八村没这么俊俏的，白天瞅，夜里睡，是个男人都眼红。第二个，屁股大能干活能生儿，他展有庆有后了。啥女人都叫他摊上了，如今闺女念书出息，领了个男人，开着车，啧啧。
继母见了她，比展有庆还热乎，“颜颜”喊不停，又把壮壮搡到跟前，摁头叫姐。展颜给了他点零钱，让他买糖吃。
知道两人要来，家里扫了地，抹了桌子，但继母不是个爱干净的，地里活儿有劲，家务活粗，胡乱搞一阵，也就算弄了。
堂屋冷的不行，展有庆把厨房的蜂窝炉提溜过来，放正中间，叫两人烤火，贺图南给展有庆递了根烟，展有庆诚惶诚恐接了去。
“展叔，我这次跟颜颜回来，是跟您说我们结婚的事，本打算初六，忘了民政局不上班，初七领证，婚礼等春天再办。”他跟展有庆实在没什么可说的，也不喜欢这里，能坐下，纯粹是因为展颜。
贺图南对小展村的印象，一直蛮糟，从少年时代起就是这样。展有庆觉得他跟他老子可真像，一眼看上去，是客客气气说话，可到底不是一路人，这份客气，完全是出于社交礼仪。
但能叫声“展叔”，也够他的了，展有庆心里有些茫然，他晓得，展颜大概是要嫁贺以诚家的，明秀没能嫁给贺以诚，到头来，闺女嫁了人儿子，怎么都得姓贺的牵上线。
“你们年轻人，这事儿，你们看着办，我没意见……”展有庆话没说完，中断了下，继母正拿眼剜他，展有庆下头就不晓得说什么了，继母端着一盘子花生瓜子过来，放油腻腻的茶几上，笑说：
“呦，你看日子过得多快，那年我记得颜颜才这么高，念中学呢，转眼都要嫁人了。颜颜，你得跟小贺说说咱们这规矩，你爸就你一个闺女，不能让人小瞧了咱家。”
展颜听得很明白，她知道继母想要东西，想要钱，她是不种还想收成的女人，春耕时不见她，等果实累累了，她来到就要摘。这样的人，随处可见，一点不稀奇。
来家里，展颜都没说什么话，被风吹着，空气寒着，心里也木木的，这也不是家，家里坐着的，没有她最想见最思念的人，几乎没有意义，空荡荡的，很陌生。
继母说这些时，她只觉得难受，妈如果在，该多好，知道她要嫁人了，她嫁的欢欢喜喜，心甘情愿。她想到明秀，连话都没有，只是很空洞地看了看继母。
“什么规矩，阿姨说我听听。”贺图南点上烟，似笑非笑，一手把玩着打火机，在烟雾缭绕中看这女人。
“颜颜这些年不在家，怕也不清楚，男方结婚前这就算是要人了，得备礼物，一头羊，一条大猪腿，十只鸡，十条鱼，十斤排骨，十斤猪肉，十篮子鸡蛋，十箱子酒，十箱子油，还得十斤水果。”
一口气说下来，贺图南以为完了，这女人后头还有，他一直微微笑着，完全理解了贺以诚当年带走展颜的心情，展颜还是展颜，开口要钱要东西的，从她奶奶，变成了继母，这家的男人，死了一样。
展颜也在这个时候想到贺以诚，当年不知晓的，突然重现了一遍，她的价值，从头至尾都是用来“敲诈”冤大头一样贺家父子的。
“看你说的，人城里不兴这个……”展有庆嘟囔着，继母不太高兴打断他，“可颜颜是你展有庆的闺女，她再是城里人，也是小展村出去的，啥也没有，你不怕人笑话？我还嫌呢。”

展颜对这种争执感觉疲惫，为什么，她总是奔波在“还”的状态里，这条路，像回忆一样，要跟到老死吗？她现在对展有庆，感情太复杂，她想起那年跟他一起去城里看妈，他给她唱“好汉歌”，问她冷不冷，她那时肯定，他是爱她的，父亲的爱真是太脆弱了，会因为另一个女人，不觉流逝掉，他不是故意流逝，而是非常自然的，有了新的女人，新的儿子，替代了她。
“我跟图南哥哥今天来，只是想告诉你们这么件事，我们要结婚。其他的事，我们没想，也不打算怎么着。”
“不管什么意思，我觉得跟您也没多大关系。”展颜淡漠看她一眼，慢慢站起来，“我们该回去了。”
展颜看着他越来越老的脸，还是那样局促，她想躲开，不愿意看。她又怜悯他了，可那又怎么样呢？他是她的爸爸，可也是壮壮的爸爸，她觉得他真讨厌，为什么这样看着她？用那张被日子布上皱纹，裹满风霜的脸，对着她，他也在为难她，她知道连孙晚秋都做不到和家里彻底切割，还是会给钱，可亲情这么尴尬着，痛苦着，他只不过是个老实巴交的普通男人，也没什么滔天大错，他好像也一堆难处，偏她还能想的到，越这样，越叫人难受。
把钱送到孙晚秋家，李彩霞倒热络招呼了几句，又夸她，展颜应付两声，去了趟爷爷家。
她只有见到爷爷，心里才慢慢平静下来，但也没留下吃饭，奶奶对她像继母那样热情，不再骂她了，她心里烦的要命，不想搭理，只想离开。
“我是这么想的，既然你们这里有这样的规矩，我可以再来一趟，找人开车把东西送来，不为别的，我不想让人背后议论，知道你结婚了，什么都没给。”贺图南不急着开车，坐那跟她商量。
贺图南说：“可你爷爷还在这生活，被问起来，他脸上不好看，我知道你不高兴，那个谁，无非就是想要点东西，给她，也就这么一回，你看行吗？”
展颜不说话了，她靠过去，贺图南伸出手摸了摸她的脸，她抬眼，喃喃说：“图南哥哥。”
她跟别人不一样，她活着，真正地活着，就得有一份很纯粹很深刻的爱，必须有爱。有的人早对这个失望了，绝望了，也没人爱，放弃跟别人的沟通，放弃期待，反正人跟人之间哪有那么多爱。有人天生感情淡漠，也不太需要这个。
她不行，没有这种爱，就像死了一样活着，不会真正快活。她生命中，只有这个事，是清晰的，分明的，不像其他，比如和展有庆不会有个结果，就这么不明不白凑合下去，她还会看他，给他钱。真实的生活，总是这样，有几件能算得清，说断就断的？
这件事，最终按贺图南说的做了，拉了足足一车，山羊还给戴朵红花，他看着那只羊，羊也看他，安静自若，任人宰割。贺图南再一次深深理解贺以诚为何执着于她和这个家彻底断掉，他内心深处，也如此希望，但因为清楚她并不想，也无法做到，他只能配合。
初六是贺图南二十六岁生日，这天，他把要结婚的事告诉了林美娟。林美娟没有丝毫惊讶，面无表情握着手机，说：“知道了。”
她想，除非是哪天接到电话，通知她贺以诚死了，她这颗心可能才会再次痉挛。她跟贺以诚一刀两断，儿子也好像不存在，儿子本来就是附属品，她误以为是爱的结晶而已。现在他早成人，爱干什么干什么去吧，哪怕展颜是他亲妹妹，他要娶，她也不会有什么好惊讶的了，这对父子，一样疯癫活在自己的逻辑里，除了那对母女，他们眼睛里没有任何人。
那老天应该单独造个空间，让这四个人在一起过日子，疯他们自己的。
“你不要觉得我还没放下，我现在心里特别平静，我只是不想去，不想见你们任何人，以后也请你不要把你觉得重要的事，再通知我，咱们各过各的。”
贺图南慢慢放下电话，妈在他没选她的那刻，就同样放弃他了，没有回头。
“林阿姨怎么说？”展颜问他，这通电话，是等贺以诚吃完饭走后打的，他走时，交代他一定要跟妈妈讲。
这么冷的天，一起洗澡非常温暖，展颜不用动的，他给她一点一点搓，打上沐浴露，起的全是泡泡。她喜欢被他这么照顾着，感觉特别安全，冲洗干净了，搞这么久，自然来了感觉，她也是，抬高了屁股，让他弄。
弄着弄着，她却哭了，贺图南好大一会儿才发觉，抱住她，问是不是弄得不舒服，哪儿疼了。

“不是，我让你没了妈妈，我心里难受。”展颜知道，他生日林美娟没有主动打电话，他打过去了，她未必有好话。
谁要是让她没了妈妈，她一定会记恨一辈子，可贺图南没有，他不恨她，他爱她。
展颜心里全是情绪，她缓了会儿，又说：“我有点害怕，图南哥哥。”
“怕很多，我怕你说我想有的没的，我这些天，有种很怪的感觉。”展颜说，“我不怕你失败，我怕我如果像我妈妈那样，不长寿，我们有了孩子，你又娶了别人，又有了孩子，我们的孩子怎么办？”
她一想到孩子如果重复自己的命运，就很痛苦，她对当母亲恐惧，恐惧生命的无常，无可挽回地失去。不仅如此，她对越来越多的身份，也有了微妙的混乱感，她是要嫁给贺图南的，她愿意的，可她对多出的身份有排斥。以后，有了孩子，她还会是某个人的妈妈，她被新的身份覆盖，就像妈妈，人们对她的称呼，其实不是明秀，全是“颜颜妈”。
在同贺图南结婚的前一夜，他的生日时刻，展颜才骤然想起孙晚秋的那些话，她不想当谁的妈。
这是她身为女性，天生要面对的东西，她渐渐摸索出这其中的真相，这是一辈子都要面对的课题。
贺图南很温柔地亲了亲她，他知道她依旧没有真正走出年少丧母的阴影，她永远在恐惧，好像厄运永远尾随其后，不晓得哪个时刻，就追上来，击倒她，摧毁她。
他当年的离开，也令她潜意识中的恐惧不断加深，她拥有很多爱，灵魂上却像个弃儿。
贺图南没有说不会的，你想太多了，他告诉她：“如果真那样，我自己带着孩子过，我不会娶任何人的，你看爸，他就是这样，他忘不了你妈妈，他会一个人走完剩下的路，对我来说，一样的。”
她需要他这样的表白心迹，她的爱，跟很多人都不同，她对他的爱，就是这样的，她听了放下心，才不会说你可以找别人，我希望你过得不要那么孤独。那不行，她想起家乡的习俗，一个男人如果娶了两回，连墓葬都是三人一起的。她不能到了阴间，还跟别的女人分享男人。
“想点好的，行不行？”贺图南点点她鼻尖，笑着说，“没发生的事，其实可以不用设想，要不然，每天都过得都不痛快，今朝有酒今朝醉，人生苦短，及时行乐，等真万一发生了不好的事，再去想也不迟。”
她一个晚上都跟他说情话，说得他躁动，他需要性来缓解压力，跟她水乳交融，才能撇掉世俗，有个依傍。他虽然不说，展颜能感觉得出，他需要她，非常需要，就像她需要他，两人咬合得天衣无缝，生来匹配。
领证这天，展颜前一晚的情绪消散了，她非常高兴，她十七岁时，就想跟他做夫妻，现在好了，真做夫妻了。
她没跟同事说，一点不急，揣着这份高兴，天天都很有劲。进入阳历二月，楼市止跌，大家依旧在观望。等到三月的时候，柳条泛青，天有了丝暖和气，房价开始缓缓上涨，人们想着涨也涨不太多，可土拍会上，地价经过几轮加价，一下上去了。
新世界上下全都松口气，年都没过好，这下心里顿时敞亮了，那些觉得贺图南昏了头的，口风渐变，贺图南突然变成个敢赌敢为的形象。孙晚秋想，自己可能要发财了，她想好了，如果发了一笔财，她可能要离开新世界，去北京闯一闯，她还没见过大城市。
公司里一片喜气洋洋，孙晚秋跟贺图南提前打了招呼，他有些意外：“想走？”他以为她来汇报事的。
孙晚秋说：“我想要，肯定不跟贺总见外，我考虑的是，这都二十五了，不算太年轻，再不出去闯闯，恐怕就晚了。”
贺图南道：“你一向都很有主意，真想走，我拦不住，我尊重你的想法，你到哪儿都能伸展开拳脚。不过你可以再考虑考虑，留在新世界，同样大有可为。”
“不会，”贺图南非常干脆，“没有什么行业是万年长青，也许我会干个五年十年，中途发现别的机遇了，也会离开的。”

孙晚秋感慨：“我也相信你，我本来觉得，念好书似乎也没什么了不起，这次，我明白了，念书学习还是非常有用的。”
孙晚秋很大方承认：“是，当年确实是，现在不了，徐牧远还在北京吗？”
贺图南没否认：“要走，也等婚礼过了，颜颜肯定要你当伴娘的，你是她最好的朋友。”
孙晚秋道：“我还没说一定走，请我当伴娘，贺总得舍得出血，我不轻易给人当伴娘。”
贺图南笑得非常松弛，孙晚秋很久没见他这么笑过了，他笑起来，跟贺以诚的样子差很多，她总是在某个瞬间，会在贺图南身上看到贺以诚的影子。其实，那个夏天，已经非常遥远了，但至今都是她最重要的记忆。
她突然觉得一阵孤独，这种东西，是展颜时常能感受到的，她好像总是在孤独。此时此刻，孙晚秋也觉得孤独，不知道是因为那个夏天，还是因为展颜已经嫁做人妇。
也许，她会永远一个人在路上，像当初离开小展村的那个夜晚，有星无月，群山黝黝，她一个人，不停走，只有不停走。
她想到展颜，少女之间那些暗微的角力、扶持、分离、陪伴都告一个段落了，她第一次为这种结束感到伤怀。
清明节前，贺图南陪展颜回去烧纸，给村小带了一批图书，他们卸书时，小孩子围着看，又摸又笑，话很多。可当展颜真跟他们说起话，他们怕生，你推我我推你，谁也不敢上前。
等给他们分了些零食，好嘛，野狗似的乱抢，高兴得不得了，到底是小孩子，有口吃的，快活死了。
漫山遍野的桃花，春天就是这样，花排着队地开，它们这么美，不管人看不看它，都要开，自在得很。
又折了两枝，去石头大爷父子那里，她出生的时候，石头大爷就是大爷的样子，等她长到二十岁，石头大爷仿佛还是那个样子，然后，死在了那个样子里。
她觉得很对不起石头大爷，他把脑袋伸进绳子里那会儿，也不晓得在想什么，无从知道了。
坟上青草盛了，就是很乱，没人拜祭，当初怎么抬到地里来，埋下去的，不晓得。这地，本来是石头大爷的地，他就一个傻儿子，也没了，这土地便扆崋被政府收了回去。谁家继续种的呢？不知道，反正两个坟头挨一块儿，四周长起麦子。
石头大爷是割麦子的一把好手，快得很，出活，年轻的时候常常带着镰刀，磨刀石，被人叫到山的那边帮忙，管饭，还能给半口袋旧粮，他给扛回来。
展颜这次在石头大爷坟前，站了许久，她心里说：石头大爷，我嫁人了呀，你可知道，以后我来看妈，就会来看你。她心里把这些话说完，心就像麦子，成熟的麦子，没来得及收呢，被大雨泡了，发了芽，烂了。
她跟贺图南两个，帮石头大爷拔草，草可真青，翠翠的，好仙灵的色儿，可这底下的白骨，也是那样的白。
放眼望去，许多人家的地里，都有坟，不晓得是谁的，许是见过的，许是连听也没听过的，活着的时候，一辈子耗死在地里。死了的时候，魂魄又在地里活着，守着庄稼，守着后人。
展颜说：“石头大爷是个好人，一辈子没享过福，死得又受罪，乡下应该不止他一个这样的，好像来世上一趟，就是受苦的。”
她想，等她也死了，世上就没人记得妈，也没人记得石头大爷了，这真让人伤心，春天多好啊，可地里头到处埋着亡魂，岁岁年年，年年岁岁，在土地上从未离去。

她不晓得以后这样的事，会不会少些，少些可怜的人，他一辈子与人为善，勤劳本分，到头来也没落着好，真是不明白到底哪里出的错，要去怪谁。

As the New Year approached, Zhanyan bought some gifts, took Sun Wanqiu's money, and went to Xiaozhan Village. She couldn't call Sun Wanqiu, nor could she call her.
There are a few more cars in the village, which are very eye-catching, so someone must be mixing them up. When she was a child, as soon as summer entered, from dusk onwards, people would be sleeping on both sides of the road with mats spread out. She also slept, turned over, and saw someone's cow pooping not far away. She was frightened by the huge penis, and watched helplessly as the big lump of cow shit fell and hit the ground. There are no cars on the road, only people. If someone rides a motorcycle, everyone will look at the person for a long time and only look away when the person is out of sight.
There are always people who have left the land and made a little fortune. I don’t know what it is like outside, but as soon as the car stops at the door, people will talk about it, and they are envious and jealous. If someone's daughter comes back from outside to buy a lot of things for the family, then she will be regarded as a takeaway in people's mouth. Who knows whether this is true or false.
But when Zhan Yan comes back, people will only say that Zhan Youqing, who can't get anything out of his body even when he stamps his feet, is blessed. The first wife was not so handsome in Shilibacun. She looked at her during the day and slept with her at night. Even every man would be jealous of her. The second one has a big butt and is able to work and have children. He is happy and has a future. He has fallen for all kinds of women, but now his daughter, who is studying for her future, married a man and drove a car, tsk tsk.
When her stepmother saw her, she was even more enthusiastic than Zhan Youqing. She kept shouting "Yanyan" and pushed Zhuangzhuang to her side and called her sister with her head pressed down. Zhanyan gave him some change and asked him to buy candies.
Knowing that the two of them were coming, the house was swept and the tables were wiped. However, the stepmother was not a tidy person. She worked vigorously in the fields and did rough housework, so she just messed around for a while and then left it alone.
The main room was extremely cold, so Zhan Youqing slipped the honeycomb stove from the kitchen over, placed it right in the middle, and asked the two of them to warm themselves up by the fire. He Tunan handed Zhan Youqing a cigarette, and Zhan Youqing took it with fear.
"Uncle Zhan, I came back with Yan Yan this time to tell you about our wedding. I originally planned to get married on the sixth day of the Lunar New Year, but I forgot that the Civil Affairs Bureau is not working. I will get the certificate on the seventh day of the Lunar New Year and wait until the spring for the wedding." He really had nothing to say to Zhan Youqing, and he didn't like it here. He could sit down purely because of Zhan Yan.
He Tunan's impression of Xiaozhan Village has always been bad, and it has been like this since he was a boy. Zhan Youqing felt that he was really similar to his father. At first glance, he seemed to be speaking politely, but in the end he was not from the same group. This politeness was purely out of social etiquette.
But being able to call him "Uncle Zhan" was enough for him. Zhan Youqing felt a little confused. He knew that Zhan Yan was probably going to marry into He Yicheng's family, but Mingxiu failed to marry He Yicheng. In the end, when his daughter married a son, he had to be married to someone named He.
"You young people, this matter is up to you, I have no objection..." Zhan Youqing stopped before he could finish his words. His stepmother was poking him out with her eyes. Zhan Youqing didn't know what to say when he lowered his head. His stepmother came over with a plate of peanuts and melon seeds, put it on the greasy coffee table, and said with a smile:
"Hey, look how fast the days go by. At that time, I remember that Yan Yan was so tall and was in middle school. She was about to get married in the blink of an eye. Yan Yan, you have to tell Xiao He about our rules. Your father is your only daughter, so we can't let others look down on our family."
Zhanyan heard it very clearly. She knew that her stepmother wanted things and money. She was a woman who wanted to harvest without sowing. She was not seen during the spring plowing. When the fruits were tired, she would pick them when she came. Such people can be found everywhere and are not unusual at all.
When she came home, Zhan Yan didn't say anything. She was blown by the wind, the air was cold, and she felt numb in her heart. This was not a home. There were no people sitting at home that she wanted to see and miss the most. It was almost meaningless, empty, and strange.
When her stepmother said this, she only felt uncomfortable. It would be great if her mother were here. Knowing that she was getting married, she married happily and willingly. She thought of Mingxiu and didn't even say anything. She just looked at her stepmother blankly.
"What are the rules? Auntie tells me, let me listen."He Tunan lit up the cigarette, half-smiling but not smiling, playing with the lighter in one hand and looking at the woman in the smoke.
"Yan Yan hasn't been at home these years, so I don't know. Before the husband gets married, he is asking for someone. He needs to prepare gifts, such as a sheep, a big pig leg, ten chickens, ten fish, ten pounds of ribs, ten pounds of pork, ten baskets of eggs, ten boxes of wine, ten boxes of oil, and ten catties of fruit."
After saying it in one breath, He Tunan thought it was over. There was still another woman behind him. He kept smiling slightly, fully understanding He Yicheng's mood when he took away Zhan Yan. Zhan Yan was still Zhan Yan, asking for money and things. From her grandmother, she became a stepmother. The man in this family was as dead as ever.
Zhanyan also thought of He Yicheng at this time. What he didn't know at the time suddenly reappeared. Her value had been used to "blackmail" the He family and his son who were the culprits from the beginning to the end.
"Look what you said, this is not popular in the city..." Zhan Youqing muttered, and his stepmother was not happy to interrupt him, "But Yanyan is your Zhan Youqing's daughter. She is from the city, but she also came from Xiaozhan Village. She has nothing. Aren't you afraid of people laughing at her? I still think so."
Zhanyan feels tired of this kind of dispute. Why is she always running in a state of "return"? Is this road, like memories, going to follow her until she grows old and dies? Her feelings for Zhan Youqing were too complicated now. She remembered that she went to the city with him to visit her mother. He sang "The Heroic Song" to her and asked her if she was cold. She was sure at that time that he loved her. Her father's love was too fragile and would pass away unconsciously because of another woman. He did not do it on purpose, but very naturally. A new woman and a new son replaced her.
"Brother Tunan and I came here today just to tell you that we are getting married. We have not thought about anything else and have no plans to do anything else."
"No matter what it means, I don't think it has much to do with you." Zhanyan looked at her indifferently and stood up slowly, "We should go back."
Zhanyan looked at his increasingly older face, still so embarrassed. She wanted to avoid it and didn't want to look at it. She felt sorry for him again, but so what? He is her father, but he is also a strong father. She thinks he is really annoying. Why is he looking at her like this? Facing her with a face that was wrinkled by life and covered with wind and frost, he was also making things difficult for her. She knew that even Sun Wanqiu could not completely cut off from the family, so he would still give her money, but the family relationship was so embarrassing and painful. He was just an honest and ordinary man, and there was nothing terribly wrong. He seemed to have a lot of difficulties, but she could still imagine that the more he was like this, the more uncomfortable it was.
After sending the money to Sun Wanqiu's house, Li Caixia greeted her warmly, praised her, put on a good face, and went to her grandfather's house.
Only when she saw her grandfather did she slowly calm down, but she didn't stay to eat. Her grandma was as enthusiastic as her stepmother and stopped scolding her. She was so upset that she didn't want to pay attention to him and just wanted to leave.
"That's what I thought. Since you have such a rule here, I can make another trip and find someone to drive to deliver the things. For no other reason than that. I don't want people to talk behind your back. I know you are married and you haven't given anything." He Tunan didn't rush to drive and sat there to discuss it with her.
He Tunan said: "But your grandfather is still living here. When asked, his face doesn't look good. I know you are unhappy. That person just wants something to give to her, just for once. Do you think it's okay?"
Zhan Yan stopped talking and leaned over. He Tunan reached out and touched her face. She raised her eyes and murmured: "Brother Tunan."
She is different from others. To live, to truly live, she must have a very pure and profound love. She must have love. Some people have long been disappointed with this. They are desperate and have no one to love them. They give up communicating with others and giving up expectations. Anyway, there is not so much love between people. Some people are naturally indifferent and don’t really need this..
She can't, without this kind of love, living as if dead, will not be truly happy. This was the only thing in her life that was clear and distinct, unlike others, such as that there would be no result with Zhan Youqing, and she would still look at him and give him money if she continued to make do with it in such a vague way. Real life is always like this. How many things can be settled and broken at the drop of a hat?
This matter was finally done as He Tunan said. He pulled a full cart and gave the goat a red flower. He looked at the sheep and the sheep looked at him, calm and composed, letting others slaughter him. He Tunan once again deeply understood why He Yicheng was obsessed with her and the family being completely cut off. Deep in his heart, he also hoped so, but because he knew that she didn't want to and couldn't do it, he could only cooperate.
The sixth day of the lunar month was He Tunan's 26th birthday. On this day, he told Lin Meijuan about his marriage. Lin Meijuan was not surprised at all. She held her phone expressionlessly and said, "I got it."
She thought that unless she received a call one day informing her that He Yicheng was dead, her heart might convulse again. She and He Yicheng broke off completely, and her son seemed to not exist. He was originally an accessory, and she mistakenly thought that he was just the crystallization of love. Now that he is an adult, he can do whatever he likes. Even if Zhanyan is his biological sister, she will not be surprised if he wants to marry her. The father and son are equally crazy and live in their own logic. Except for the mother and daughter, there is no one in their eyes.
Then God should create a separate space for these four people to live together and go crazy on their own.
"Don't think that I haven't given up yet. I feel very calm now. I just don't want to go or see any of you. Please don't inform me about anything you think is important in the future. Let's live our own lives."
He Tunan slowly put down the phone. The moment his mother didn't choose her, she gave up on him and never looked back.
"What did Aunt Lin say?" Zhan Yan asked him. This call was made after He Yicheng finished eating and left. When he left, he told him that he must tell his mother.
On such a cold day, it was very warm to take a bath together. She didn't need to move her face. He rubbed her little by little and applied shower gel, making bubbles all over her. She liked being taken care of by him like this. She felt very safe. After being rinsed off and fucked for so long, it felt natural. She also raised her buttocks and let him fuck her.
While he was playing with it, she started to cry. It took a while for He Tunan to realize it, so he hugged her and asked if it made her feel uncomfortable and where it hurt.
"No, I made you lose your mother, and I feel sad." Zhanyan knew that Lin Meijuan didn't take the initiative to call her on his birthday. If he called her, she might not have anything good to say.
If anyone made her lose her mother, she would definitely hold a grudge for the rest of her life, but He Tunan didn't. He didn't hate her, he loved her.
Zhanyan's heart was full of emotions. She calmed down for a while and then said, "I'm a little scared, Brother Tunan."
"I'm afraid that you will say that I don't have what I want. I have a very strange feeling these days." Zhanyan said, "I'm not afraid of your failure. I'm afraid that if I don't live long like my mother, and we have children, and you marry someone else and have children, what will happen to our children?"
She is very painful when she thinks about her child repeating her fate. She is afraid of being a mother, afraid of the impermanence of life and irreparable loss. Not only that, she also had a subtle sense of confusion about more and more identities. She wanted to marry He Tunan, and she was willing, but she was repelled by the extra identities. In the future, when she has a child, she will still be someone's mother. She will be covered by a new identity, just like mother. In fact, people call her not Mingxiu, but "Yanyan mother".
The night before her wedding to He Tunan, on his birthday, Zhanyan suddenly remembered Sun Wanqiu's words. She didn't want to be anyone's mother.
This is something she is born to face as a woman, and she gradually finds out the truth., this is a lifelong issue.
He Tunan kissed her tenderly. He knew that she still had not really gotten over the shadow of losing her mother when she was young. She was always in fear, as if bad luck was always following her, and he didn't know when it would catch up with her, knock her down, and destroy her.
His departure that year also deepened her subconscious fear. She had a lot of love, but she felt like an abandoned child in her soul.
He Tunan didn't say no, you think too much. He told her: "If that happens, I will take care of the child by myself and I will not marry anyone. Look at dad, he is like this. He will never forget your mother. He will walk the rest of the way alone. To me, it's the same."
She needs this kind of confession from him. Her love is different from that of many people. Her love for him is just like this. After hearing this, she feels relieved and won't say that you can find someone else. I hope you won't be so lonely. That didn't work. She remembered the custom in her hometown. If a man married twice, the three of them would be buried together. She cannot go to the underworld and share a man with another woman.
"Think of something good, okay?" He Tunan nodded the tip of her nose and said with a smile, "In fact, you don't have to think about things that haven't happened. Otherwise, every day will be unhappy. If you have wine now, you will be drunk now. Life is short, so be happy in the moment. If something bad happens, it won't be too late to think about it again."
She kept talking to him about love all night long, which made him restless. He needed sex to relieve stress, and to be in harmony with her, so that he could leave the world behind and have someone to rely on. Although he didn't say it, Zhan Yan could feel that he needed her, very much, just like she needed him. The two fit together perfectly, and were born to match each other.
On the day she received the certificate, her emotions from the night before Zhan Yan dissipated and she was very happy. When she was seventeen, she had wanted to be husband and wife with him, and now they are good and they are really husband and wife.
She didn't tell her colleagues that she was not in a hurry. With this happiness, she was very energetic every day. Entering February of the Gregorian calendar, the property market has stopped falling, and everyone is still waiting and watching. By March, when the wicker branches were turning green and the sky was warm, housing prices began to rise slowly. People thought that the increase would not be too much, but at the land auction, after several rounds of price increases, land prices suddenly went up.
Everyone in the New World breathed a sigh of relief. They had not had a good year, and their hearts suddenly became brighter. Those who thought He Tunan had lost his mind gradually changed their tone, and He Tunan suddenly became a person who dared to gamble and take action. Sun Wanqiu thought that she might make a fortune. She had thought about it. If she made a fortune, she might leave the New World and go to Beijing to try her luck. She had never seen a big city.
